text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the Mile Championship on the<n>horizon, Taiki
Shuttle seeks to make a<n>bigger name for herself in
order to<n>become Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the midst of this, she is met with a<n>challenge
from Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If Taiki can steal the hearts of the<n>fans by beating
the unstoppable force<n>that is Silence Suzuka, she
just might<n>be able to clinch the title.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle's chances of becoming<n>Umamusume
of the Year hinge on<n>winning the Mile
Championship!
